now.title: D9 Retention and replay: Task 8 manifest
now.detail: Tasks 1-7 done: classes, holds, retention protocol, crash-safe purge with tombstones, re-fetch with hash check, licence ends and restore that purges first. Task 8 in progress: an independently authored frozen Stage 5 manifest (expectations decided by hand from fixtures and the spec), then Sol approval before the Stage 5 end-to-end (Task 9).

D7 Tasks 5-6 once the owner's real Screener CSV is in data/raw/screener-exports/; D7 phase-end review
